_comment: Board rotation weights. Higher = shown more often. Seeded by hand today; scripts/update_weights.py will overwrite these from real Fare Finder search counts once search logging is live. Rotation multiplies a deal's discount score by its weight and by a recency penalty, so popular cities appear often but never permanently.

recency_penalty._comment: Multiplier applied when a city was on the board recently. Index = days since last shown.
